name: components-backgrounds-bubble
title: Bubble Background
blurb: Animated blur orbs float and pulse across the background.
description: Motion/react background with six configurable color orbs using blur effects. Optional interactive mode for pointer tracking with spring physics.
use_when: Modern gradient background with soft blob aesthetic.
avoid_when: Performance-critical pages or high frame rate requirements.
a11y: Decorative animation; pointer tracking has no keyboard equivalent.
